name: Chip design
licenseNote: The add-on's own code is Apache-2.0, like the core. It can run tools you installed yourself — including GPL tools such as Icarus Verilog, KLayout and Netgen — as separate programs that it talks to through files and command lines; it never contains, links or downloads them.
description: Chip design from Verilog to layout, kept as a project with each run's tool versions and hashes. Studio runs tools you install yourself (Icarus Verilog, Yosys; not run by us yet: Verilator, OpenROAD, KLayout, Netgen), GPL ones as separate programs; nothing is bundled. Core Apache-2.0. For learning and open-silicon flows, not a signed-off tape-out system; we ship no PDK and make no foundry claims.
author: CadCraft
honesty: For learning and open-silicon flows, not a signed-off tape-out system. We ship no PDK and make no foundry claims. Run by us on the sample design: Icarus Verilog 11, Yosys 0.9. Not run by us yet: Verilator, OpenROAD, KLayout, Netgen.
